result: The authors propose that in silico modeling of drug-receptor complexes could enable strategic redesign of antiandrogen drugs to overcome resistance mutations in prostate cancer. This represents a potential computational approach to developing designer antiandrogens that maintain efficacy against resistant cancer variants.
status_reasoning: Claims C1 and C2 are explicitly speculative ('may be possible'), indicating this is a proposed approach rather than a demonstrated result. Claim C4 is an inference from the title without supporting data. No experimental validation, computational results, or proof-of-concept data are presented to support the feasibility or effectiveness of this strategy.

result: Mutations cause drug resistance in prostate cancer, providing the biological rationale for developing resistance-evading therapeutics.
status_reasoning: Claim C3 represents established scientific knowledge about prostate cancer drug resistance mechanisms. This is well-documented in the literature and serves as accepted background knowledge rather than a novel finding requiring validation in this manuscript.
